title: Templify AI
lede: Templify is an iPhone editor that turns raw clips and photos into short-form videos, photo posts and carousels by dropping them into ready-made designer templates, with no timeline to learn.

points: Offers more than 1,200 templates for Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and collages.
Editing tools include AI video editing, beat-synced transitions, auto captions, background removal and an AI Studio.
A new Brand Kit saves colors, fonts and a logo once and applies them to any template.
A Mac version now sits alongside the iPhone app.
The team calls Brand Kit the first step toward Creator Brain, an assistant meant to help decide what to post.

sections.text: Founders, small shops and coaches who want polished social content without learning to edit, according to the team's comments.
Free to use on iPhone and Mac, with an optional Pro subscription.
